item.title: Pokémon Pokopia will have plenty of post-credits content
item.description: The upcoming sandbox Pokémon Pokopia looks like it might be one of the IP's greatest spinoffs yet. item.title: Everything you need to know about the dart frog toxin allegedly used to kill Alexei Navalny
item.description: Two years after the death of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny, the UK and several European allies say they have identified the substance that likely caused it: a rare neurotoxin known as epibatidine. According to the UK Foreign Office, traces of the toxin were found in samples taken from Navalny's body following his death in a Siberian penal colony. item.title: Zelensky says US too often asks Ukraine for concessions, but not Russia
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Saturday that the United States too often asks Ukraine, rather than Russia, to make concessions in peace talks, as he expressed hope that next week's US-brokered meetings in Geneva would be "serious and substantive."
